$comment: Transcribed by hand from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFBH (AIP France, chart dated 2026-02-19): the text pages checked against the images of the pages.
Only what the chart states is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text; the reporting points, rules and notes were added by hand.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
No circuit height or circuit side is printed on this chart, so none is recorded; the published circuit is a drawing and is not read.

The reporting points are in French: "location" is the name printed in the French column of the chart, copied and not translated, and "purpose" is written in French; a point whose French name could not be read has no "location". Only "spoken.en" is English: the name the English phraseology says over the radio.

The French of "circuit", "withAts" and "withoutAts" is in "fr": same tree as the English, text values only, written by hand from the French column of the chart where it was read, and translated from the English text otherwise; point and runway identifiers are repeated unchanged.

service.atsHours: Monday to Sunday: summer 0530 to 2030, winter 0630 to 1930 (UTC in winter, local time minus 1 h in summer)

circuit.restrictions: to limit noise, the published circuit must be complied with, except for safety reasons or on ATC instruction

departures.note: climb straight ahead to at least 1000 ft ASFC, then intercept the ring road before Lagord and follow it; northbound departure: turn between Lagord and Puilboreau; southbound departure: follow the ring road

arrivals.note: runway 27: make the final turn by intercepting and following the ring road to the runway centreline; PAPI is mandatory

notes: Special VFR meteorological minima with IFR flights, visibility on the routes: N-E 2400 m; S-E 3000 m; N-NA 1600 m; NA-EA 1500 m (1200 m for helicopters); E-EA 1500 m (1200 m for helicopters).

Class 2, 3, 4 and 6 ULM may use the aerodrome if they fly at least 100 km/h during take-off and climb and 120 km/h during arrival and landing; ULM that cannot respect these speeds must have left the CTR or landed 30 minutes before any IFR movement.
Platform and runway congestion must be limited: clear the axes as soon as possible after take-off and vacate the runway quickly after landing.
The aerodrome can be covered by sea haze within a few minutes.
TODA and ASDA of runway 09 are reduced: depart from the turn-around pad because of the localizer antenna. TORA, ASDA and LDA of runway 27 are reduced (RESA 90 x 90 m inside the aerodrome).

Hot spot: intersection between a taxiway and the helicopter translation taxiway; pay sharp attention. The main holding point A and the intermediate holding points B, C, D and G1 must never be crossed without ATC clearance.
Pilot-controlled lighting is reserved exclusively for home-based helicopters flying public service missions.
Aerobatics no. 6058 and parachuting no. 317: see AIP ENR 5.5.

Minimums météorologiques : En présence d'IFR, visibilité : VIS itinéraire (N-E) : 2400 m ; VIS itinéraire (S-E) : 3000 m ; VIS itinéraire (N-NA) : 1600 m ; VIS itinéraire (NA-EA) : 1500 m (1200 m HEL) ; VIS itinéraire (E-EA) : 1500 m (1200 m HEL). Parachutage (N° 317) : voir AIP ENR 5.5.

circuit.lowHeight: vols d'entraînement uniquement, avec instructeur à bord : 300 ft AAL minimum, au nord de la piste 09/27 et avec l'autorisation de l'ATC
circuit.restrictions: pour limiter le bruit, respecter le circuit publié, sauf pour raison de sécurité ou sur instruction de l'ATC

departures.note: monter dans l'axe jusqu'à 1000 ft ASFC au moins, puis intercepter la rocade avant Lagord et la suivre ; départ vers le nord : virer entre Lagord et Puilboreau ; départ vers le sud : suivre la rocade

arrivals.note: piste 27 : effectuer le dernier virage en interceptant et suivant la rocade jusqu'à l'axe de piste ; PAPI obligatoire
